source.title: The Constitution of India
source.authority: Government of India, Ministry of Law and Justice, Legislative Department

rules: Use the listed constitutional provisions as the primary constitutional reference for the lesson.
Do not invent Article numbers, Parts, Schedules, constitutional powers or constitutional procedures.
If a topic is conceptual and has no single Article, explain the concept without inventing a specific Article.
Distinguish clearly between a constitutional provision, a law made under the Constitution, a court interpretation and a general democratic principle.
The constitutional source is the factual foundation; examples and explanations must not contradict it.
